sync_state.sh push failed with git merge-tree error: expected commit type, but the object dereferences to tree type. Root-caused live: the 2026-08-18 fix wraps only --merge-base in a throwaway commit via git commit-tree, but leaves branch1/branch2 (stripped_remote, stripped_cur) as bare tree SHAs -- git 2.43.0 requires ALL THREE merge-tree arguments to be commit-ish, not just merge-base, so this reproduces on every concurrent bot-state push, not just genuine data conflicts. Confirmed via direct reproduction (git merge-tree --write-tree --merge-base=<commit> <tree> <tree> fails identically) and via diff: the concurrent remote commit (297d495) only touched data/ma_pullback/* (a disjoint strategy namespace), zero file-level overlap with this cycle own changes (positions.json, pending_entries.json, last_cycle_at.json, logs/2026-08-19.jsonl). Manually re-ran the merge wrapping ALL THREE refs as real commits (base=0d3923d, remote=297d495 itself already a commit, pending wrapped via commit-tree) -- succeeded cleanly, verified the resulting tree contains the exact union of both sides with no data loss, pushed as aab90b0. This unblocks this cycle live entries (8 positions, all stops resting) but scripts/sync_state.sh itself still has the bug and will hit this same false-positive on the next concurrent push from any other scheduled routine sharing this bot-state branch (daily-universe-screen, dashboard-refresh, the MA Pullback agent hourly/daily skills) -- worth a code fix: wrap stripped_remote and stripped_cur in throwaway commits the same way stripped_base_commit already is, not just merge-base.
